# Opower fixtures

Response shapes of the Opower API (`pge.opower.com`), adapted from the tests of
[tronikos/opower](https://github.com/tronikos/opower) (Apache-2.0), whose
identifiers and values are made up: `customers-pge.json` (multi-account-v1),
`forecast-pge.json` (dsm-graphql-v1 bill forecast, gas in `TH`),
`daily-cost-pge.json` (DataBrowser-v1 cost reads with tiered components and a
trailing zero read), `usage-fallback-pge.json` (an empty cost answer, then the
usage endpoint).
